item.title: Rangers muster just nine shots on goal in loss to Senators
item.description: Franklin Square native Shane Pinto scored one of the Senators' two goals.

item.title: Bulls race to 20-point lead in 1st quarter, hang on to beat the Rockets 132-124
item.description: Matas Buzelis' layup in the final seconds put Chicago ahead to stay and Collin Sexton came off the bench to score 25 points as the Chicago Bulls beat the Houston Rockets 132-124.

item.title: A 1,000-year-old cliff-top temple lies battered after Cambodia-Thailand border clashes
item.description: Cambodia says fighting with Thailand has left the Preah Vihear temple badly damaged and too dangerous for visitors.

item.title: Dodgers pitcher Roki Sasaki struggles again in exhibition start against the Angels
item.description: Los Angeles Dodgers pitcher Roki Sasaki is still struggling with the regular season approaching.

item.title: Theegala finds a fairway and leads LA to late victory over Jupiter for 1-0 lead in TGL final
item.description: Sahith Theegala couldn't find a fairway until it mattered for Los Angeles.

item.title: 6 injured, 2 seriously, in chain-reaction crash on Veterans Memorial Highway in Hauppauge
item.description: The impact caused a Mazda CX30 to catch fire, which spread to a Tesla, police said.

item.title: Cernak scores on crazy carom late in 3rd period as the Wild beat the Lightning 6-3
item.description: Erik Cernak scored a tiebreaking goal with 2:53 left in the third period when Minnesota goaltender Filip Gustavsson misplayed a carom off the end boards and the Tampa Bay Lightning beat the Wild 6-3.

item.title: Forsberg has a goal and 2 assists to lead surging Predators over slumping Sharks 6-3
item.description: Filip Forsberg scored a goal and assisted on two others to lead the Nashville Predators to a 6-3 victory over the San Jose Sharks in a matchup of teams headed in opposite directions in the standings.

item.title: Chicano Studies program pioneer Rudy Acuña dies at 93
item.description: Pioneering political activist and historian Rodolfo "Rudy" Acuña, who founded one of the first Chicano Studies programs offered by a major university, has died at 93.

item.title: Mitchell scores 42 as Cavaliers defeat Magic 136-131 to extend winning streak to 4 games
item.description: Donovan Mitchell scored 42 points, James Harden added 26 and the Cleveland Cavaliers beat the Orlando Magic 136-131 to extend their winning streak to four games.

item.title: Hofer makes 21 saves to help Blues beat Washington 3-0
item.description: Jimmy Snuggerud and Otto Stenberg scored, Joel Hofer made 21 saves and the St. Louis Blues beat the Washington Capitals 3-0 on Tuesday night.

item.title: Scheifele sparks Jets with a goal, 2 assists and a rare fight in a 4-1 win over Golden Knights
item.description: Mark Scheifele had a goal and two assists and a rare fighting major in the second period to lead the Winnipeg Jets to a 4-1 victory over the Vegas Golden Knights.

item.title: Stocks rise and oil prices ease as Wall Street keeps yo-yoing because of the war with Iran
item.description: Hope for a possible end to the war with Iran is pushing stocks higher again, while oil prices ease.

item.title: Knicks' Jalen Brunson leads club into virtual tie with Celtics in East
item.description: Brunson scored 32 points, including 15 in the fourth quarter.
